items.requirement: Network/Wi-Fi coverage, availability, and stability across all AMR operational areas (including docking and charging zones)
Static IP address allocation for AMRs, DFleet and Remote IO
MAC address registration or network whitelist requirements
Network security restrictions (firewall rules, VLANs, port access)
Accessibility to required system interfaces (ERP, WMS, MES, REST API, database, etc.)
Availability of IT personnel for network configuration and troubleshooting
Allocated location for DFleet server
Power specifications (voltage, phase, current capacity)
Power supply availability for DFleet server
Availability of UPS backup for servers, networking equipment, or control systems (if required)
Aisle/pathway width and navigation clearance along all AMR routes (Requirement is ≥ 1000 mm width)
Clearance around docking stations and pickup/drop-off locations
Availability of sufficient fixed environmental features for reliable trackless navigation and localization
Identification of areas with abnormal magnetic disturbances that may affect IMU functionality
Reflector installation approval and proposed locations (if required by navigation system)
Identification of temporary obstacles (pallets, carts, boxes, etc.)
Identification of potential AMR traffic swapping stations
Floor condition (levelness, slope, cracks, bumps) — confirmed within maximum allowable slope for AMR operation (≤ 10 mm Non-rigid protrusions, working slope must be ≤ 5% / 3°)
Floor surface quality (anti-slip, reflective, dusty, oily, etc.)
Drain covers, floor joints, rails, or trenches affecting AMR movement (Trench width must be ≤ 30mm)
Environmental conditions (temperature, humidity, dust levels) (0-40°C, No dust, flammable, explosive or corrosive gases)
Defined pedestrian walkways and forklift traffic areas
Emergency stop procedures and emergency access paths
Identification of fast moving obstacles
AMR moving speed restriction
Number of charging stations required
Allocated charging station locations
Charging strategy (opportunity charging vs scheduled charging)
Dimensions and specifications of trolley, pallet, or load carriers
Docking or hooking mechanism requirements
Payload weight and center-of-gravity considerations
Tolerance for docking alignment
Availability of site personnel for deployment coordination
Site access procedure for deployment team (registration, security clearance, PPE requirements, visitor pass, etc.)
Permitted working hours / time window for installation, testing, and commissioning
Access to operational areas during deployment and mapping activities
